programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk has to go into the forest / Mr. Monk muss in den Wald
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives together with his six children as a single father. Together, despite their impossible father, the children try to master their lives on creative, scandalosis, but also warmly. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all of this in the home living room _ The "Yoga magazine" makes it possible. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA conference league / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021. Years of football lovers enjoy the League Conference organized by UEFA. The idea for her appeared in 2015. years, and includes lower ranked teams of state championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams that are divided into eight groups per four are entered into the competition. 16 teams progresses in the eighth final, then quarterfinals, semifinals and finals. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Great Sporting Moments
programme.desc: Magazine on the highest moments in the history of sports. / Magazin o najvećim trenucima u istoriji sporta.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Cycling: Croatian Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Хърватия
programme.desc: The Tour of Croatia is one of the most significant events in cycling that attracts world professional teams and is part of the European Calendar of the UCI. The tour offers exciting stages that go through some of the most beautiful landscapes of Croatia-from the Adriatic coast to the interior of the country. / Обиколката на Хърватия (Tour of Croatia) е едно от най-значимите събития в колоезденето, което привлича световни професионални отбори и е част от Европейския календар на UCI. Турът предлага вълнуващи етапи, които преминават през някои от най-красивите пейзажи на Хърватия — от Адриатическото крайбрежие до вътрешността на страната.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Through the Time Corridors with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: What if Comerta is not the end? In order to live again, we need to resurrect bodies and minds and scientists develop ways to preserve the virtually restraint of our brain. [Al] / Какво ако cмъртта не е краят? За да живеем отново, трябва да възкреcим телата и умовете cи и учените развиват начини да запазят виртуално cъдържанието на мозъка ни. [AL]

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Antoaneta Frankeva / Зала на славата: Антоанета Френкева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Sailing: Grand Prix of Britain / Ветроходство: Гран при на Великобритания
programme.desc: The event is held in Portsmouth, UK. 12 national teams with high -speed F50, up to 100 km/h, participate. In this type of competition they are not winning the technology of the vessel, but the crew and the strategy. / Събитието се провежда в Портсмут, Великобритания. Участват 12 национални отбора с високоскоростни катамарани тип F50, достигащи до 100 км/ч. В този вид състезание побеждават не технологията на плавателния съд, а екипажът и стратегията.

programme.title: With BNT forever / С БНТ завинаги
programme.desc: Dragomir Draganov will welcome viewers in the studio of "With BNT Forever" to tell with his star guests the unforgettable and exciting stories of the great Bulgarian artists and artists. "With BNT forever" is a natural continuation of BNT of 60 and, like it, will remain a reserved territory for memories and rethinking. / Драгомир Драганов ще посреща зрителите в студиото на "С БНТ завинаги", за да разказва заедно със звездните си гости незабравими и вълнуващи истории на големите български артисти и творци. "С БНТ завинаги" е естествено продължение на "БНТ на 60" и също като него ще остане запазена територия за спомени и преосмисляне.

programme.title: Forgotten by God / Забравени от Бога
programme.desc: Jonas and Beno are a gay couple in Amsterdam. Jonas opens a new bar, but on the same day the hooligans beat Beno. Jonas is furious, especially when he realizes that Beno is cheating on him with the bartender. He pours his anger on Rohs, who dies from internal hemorrhage two days later. / Джонас и Бено са гей двойка в Амстердам. Джонас отваря нов бар, но в същия ден хулигани пребиват Бено. Джонас е бесен, особено когато разбира, че Бено му изневерява с бармана. Излива гнева си върху Рохи, който умира от вътрешен кръвоизлив два дни по-късно.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Lotte - Freiburg, Football, German Cup / Lotte - Freiburg, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: NINE FOR IX - (S01, E06, Sport. Program, USA, 2013) Documentary series of 40. Anniversary of the Law Adoption Directed against Discrimination in educational institutions financed by the United States. programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: As one of the oldest still existing news programs on German television, the magazine has been broadcast since December 1952. The current events are reported at home and abroad. / Als eine der altesten noch bestehenden Nachrichtensendungen im deutschen Fernsehen wird das Magazin bereits seit Dezember 1952 ausgestrahlt. Berichtet wird uber das aktuelle Geschehen im In- und Ausland.

programme.title: Are we still a people? / Sind wir noch ein Volk?
programme.desc: The German democracy has never been under pressure as now. Are we still a "community of fate"? What happened when Germany was attacked from the outside? Were we standing together or was everyone looking for the width? Is Germany long too dispute, split and torn into the different political camps or can you find common ground in between? The film "Are we still a people?" portrays eight people from a wide variety of milieus, accompanies them in their everyday life and gathers them at a virtual talk table. They were never met in the reality and if, they were not listened to each other or misunderstood. But on average the conversation arises, in this film they are forced to listen to each other: a Pegida-Grunder meets a Turkish-stem, Muslim rapper, a rage farmer on a climate adhesive, a still convinced pacifist to a former military service, who has decided in view of the terrible pictures from the Ukraine decline To be trained. They exchange information about the trigger topics of this society: migration and climate, war and gender. They speak of their views of democracy and about what is going wrong in this country, which separates and splits us, but also what they want for the future. So everyone becomes miserable with their or their perspective; in his or her political attitude. And so it becomes clear how far the positions are apart, how fundamentally different the ideas are. The question arises: How much pluralism can German society endure? Is not also part of a healthy democracy as long as we give the other a room with his opinion. The film does not conclude that the viewers themselves can. It becomes clear that there is no simple answer to the question "Are we still a people?" And we have to talk urgently. / Noch nie war die bundesdeutsche Demokratie so unter Druck wie jetzt. Sind wir noch eine "Schicksalsgemeinschaft"? Was wurde passieren, wenn Deutschland von auSSen angegriffen wurde? Wurden wir zusammenstehen oder wurde jeder fur sich das Weite suchen? Ist Deutschland langst viel zu zerstritten, gespalten und zerrissen in die unterschiedlichen politischen Lager oder lassen sich auch dazwischen Gemeinsamkeiten finden?Der Film "Sind wir noch ein Volk?" portratiert acht Menschen aus den unterschiedlichsten Milieus, begleitet sie in ihrem Alltag und versammelt sie an einem virtuellen Gesprachstisch. In der Realitat wurden sie nie aufeinander treffen und wenn, wurden sie einander nicht zuhoren oder unverstanden auseinander gehen. Doch im Schnitt entsteht das Gesprach, im Film werden sie auf diese Weise gezwungen, einander zuzuhoren: Ein Pegida-Grunder trifft auf eine turkisch-stammige, muslimische Rapperin, ein Wut-Bauer auf eine Klimakleberin, eine noch immer uberzeugte Pazifistin auf einen ehemaligen Wehrdienstverweigerer, der angesichts der schrecklichen Bilder aus dem Ukrainekrieg entschlossen hat, sich nun doch militarisch ausbilden zu lassen.Sie tauschen sich aus uber die Triggerthemen dieser Gesellschaft: Migration und Klima, Krieg und Gender. Sie sprechen uber ihre Auffassungen von Demokratie und daruber, was schief lauft in diesem Land, was uns trennt und spaltet, aber auch was sie sich fur die Zukunft wunschen. So wird Jeder und Jede verstandlich mit seiner oder ihrer Perspektive; in seiner oder ihrer politischen Haltung. Und so wird deutlich, wie weit die Positionen auseinanderliegen, wie grundsatzlich unterschiedlich die Vorstellungen sind.Es stellt sich die Frage: Wieviel Pluralismus kann die deutsche Gesellschaft aushalten? Ist Meinungsvielfalt nicht auch Teil einer gesunden Demokratie, solange wir dem anderen mit seiner Meinung einen Raum geben. Der Film zieht kein Fazit, das konnen die Zusehenden selbst. Dabei wird deutlich, dass es keine einfache Antwort auf die Frage gibt "Sind wir noch ein Volk?" und wir dringend reden mussen.

programme.sub-title: Put the cell phone away! Are we powerless against social media? / Leg doch mal das Handy weg! Sind wir machtlos gegen Social Media?
programme.desc: Moderator Louis Klamroth discusses current topics from politics, business and society with his guest. The content for the audience is made miserable and comprehensively explained. Die Inhalte werden fur das Publikum verstandlich gemacht und umfassend erklart. Den Zuschauern ist es sogar moglich, sich am Gesprach zu beteiligen.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.sub-title: To a hair / Um ein Haar

programme.title: Germany Stahlhart - Ost and West combined in change? / Deutschland stahlhart - Ost und West im Umbruch vereint?
programme.desc: Far in the sudwest of Germany, in Saarlouis, and far in the east, in Eisenhuttenstadt, the signs are on change. The steel industry not only takes care of jobs to Saar and or or or creates cohesion. Since then, both regions have lived through beautiful, but also hard times. The crises of the German steel industry were and can be experienced here directly. Non is about survival of the locations. In order to consist of the cheap steel from all over the world, industry is to be switched to a more climate -friendly production. The Dillinger Hutte at Saarlouis and the steel mill in Eisenhuttenstadt go various ways. But for both partner regions it is about their industry, their future, their identity. An Saar und Oder sorgt die Stahlindustrie nicht nur fur Jobs, sondern stiftet Zusammenhalt.Noch vor der Wiedervereinigung haben die beiden Stadte die erste deutsch-deutsche Stadtepartnerschaft gegrundet, damals weltweit ein Politikum. Seitdem haben beide Regionen schone, aber auch harte Zeiten durchlebt. Die Krisen der deutschen Stahlindustrie waren und sind hier unmittelbar erfahrbar.Nun geht es ums Überleben der Standorte. Auch um gegen den Billigstahl aus aller Welt zu bestehen, soll die Industrie auf eine klimafreundlichere Produktion umgestellt werden.Die Dillinger Hutte bei Saarlouis und das Stahlwerk in Eisenhuttenstadt gehen dabei verschiedene Wege. Aber fur beide Partnerregionen geht es um ihre Industrie, ihre Zukunft, ihre Identitat. Was macht das mit den Menschen, den Jungen und den Erfahrenen, die diesen Umbruch gestalten und durchleben mussen?

At the same time, the likeable teacher has learned that Gregor has recently been the owner of a moon -having condominium in the Thailand metropolis - since he actually had to finally go back to his wife to Germany after years abroad. Vicky briefly travels to Bangkok against her sister Tina (Maria Bachmann). Here the evidence that Gregor had an affarity - but with whom? Since his secretary (Michèle Marian) can crafted any suspicion, only one woman is possible for Vicky: Gregor's much younger, attractive boss June van Driel (Bettina Zimmermann). She is looking for June, whom she never seen before, in her town house in Bangkok. However, Harriet van Driel (Gertrud Roll), the strict mother of the entrepreneur, believes that in Vicky the applicant for the job as a private teacher of June Little Daughter Anna (Franziska Neding). Without really wanting it, the stunned Vicky gets involved in confusion - she sees it a chance to get certainty about her suspicion and to learn more about her husband's supposed double life. In fact, she gets the job and, shortly afterwards, travels with the van Driels to the north of Thailand, where June liked to do a sympathetic brother Tim (Guntbert Warns). During the little Anna soon closed her new teacher in her heart, the Kuhle Harriet is suspicious. Meanwhile, between June, which hides her vulnerability behind a facade of rigor and discipline, and the motherly Vicky is developing an exciting, but at the same time strangely familiar relationship. When Vicky is convinced to finally have enough evidence of her husband's infidelity, she wants to confront her rival. Before this happens, she is confronted with a terrible truth by the young woman: June is incurable to cancer and only has to live for a few months. Shortly afterwards Harriet finds out that Vicky is not the person to be to be. / Die Nachricht kommt fur Victoria "Vicky" Wessendorf (Suzanne von Borsody) wie ein Schock: Ihr Mann Gregor, der seit vielen Jahren in Thailand als Ingenieur arbeitete, ist in Bangkok bei einem Verkehrsunfall ums Leben gekommen. Zugleich erfahrt die sympathische Lehrerin, dass Gregor seit Kurzem Besitzer einer mondanen Eigentumswohnung in der thailandischen Metropole war - dabei hatte er doch eigentlich vor, nach Jahren im Ausland endlich zu seiner Frau nach Deutschland zuruckzukehren. Gegen den Rat ihrer Schwester Tina (Maria Bachmann) reist Vicky kurz entschlossen nach Bangkok. Hier verdichten sich die Hinweise, dass Gregor eine Affare hatte - aber mit wem? Da seine Sekretarin (Michèle Marian) jeden Verdacht glaubhaft entkraften kann, kommt fur Vicky nur noch eine Frau infrage: Gregors wesentlich jungere, attraktive Chefin June van Driel (Bettina Zimmermann). Sie sucht June, die sie nie zuvor gesehen hat, in deren Stadthaus in Bangkok auf. Allerdings glaubt Harriet van Driel (Gertrud Roll), die strenge Mutter der Unternehmerin, in Vicky die Bewerberin fur die Stelle als Privatlehrerin von Junes kleiner Tochter Anna (Franziska Neiding) vor sich zu haben. Ohne es wirklich zu wollen, lasst die verdutzte Vicky sich auf die Verwechslung ein - sieht sie darin doch eine Chance, sich Gewissheit uber ihren Verdacht zu verschaffen und mehr uber das vermeintliche Doppelleben ihres Mannes zu erfahren. Tatsachlich bekommt sie den Job und reist kurz darauf mit den van Driels in den Norden Thailands, wo Junes sympathischer Bruder Tim (Guntbert Warns) eine Teeplantage betreibt. Wahrend die kleine Anna ihre neue Lehrerin schon bald in ihr Herz geschlossen hat, ist die kuhle Harriet misstrauisch. Derweil entwickelt sich zwischen June, die ihre Verletzlichkeit hinter einer Fassade aus Strenge und Disziplin verbirgt, und der mutterlichen Vicky eine spannungsvolle, zugleich aber seltsam vertraute Beziehung. Als Vicky uberzeugt ist, endlich genug Beweise fur die Untreue ihres Mannes zu haben, will sie ihre Rivalin zur Rede stellen. Bevor es dazu kommt, wird sie von der jungen Frau mit einer furchtbaren Wahrheit konfrontiert: June ist unheilbar an Krebs erkrankt und hat nur noch wenige Monate zu leben. Kurz darauf findet Harriet heraus, dass Vicky nicht die Person ist, die zu sein sie vorgibt.

Mit viel Begeisterung kontrolliert er so gut wie jedes Wochenende die Fahrkarten, fertigt die Zuge ab und offnet und schlieSSt die Schranken.Willi bekommt von seinen Eltern ein besonderes Geschenk: Er darf bei der Buckower Kleinbahn in Brandenburg seinen "Ehrenlokfuhrer" machen. programme.title: Marchenreise
programme.desc: "Salt is more valuable than gold and gemstones," claims Princess Amelie im ARD-Marchen "Die Salt Princess". But is that really true or does she only pay Marchen? Did there really be a time when salt was so important? What about these small, white grain? Moderator Clarissa Correa da Silva embarks on a trip to March through Germany: In the footsteps of the salt princess. On Buckeburg Castle in Lower Saxony, she learns in the castle cake why cooking is great and why people were starved without the so -called "pokeln". On the further discovery tour, Clarissa is amazed that Luneburg is the salt city of the north. There she meets people who explain to her why salt was called "The White Gold" and which is why the city has become so rich. Salt was transported all over the world from Luneburg - but how? Clarissa leads the answer to a "Salz-Ewer", an old wooden barge with which you drive over the river. But she was already sweating, because there was no engine at the time and the boat crew does not protect Clarissa when driving against the current. After all, it remains clear to Clarissa: How do you actually get salt? When visiting a salt boiler, she has good to do - because of course Luneburg does not want to leave Luneburg without salt and has to learn to win salt from salt water. Clarissa wonders: is that different? And yes, the white grain is also available in mines, for example in Thuringen. Here Clarissa explores an incredibly long tunnel at a depth of 800 meters and immerses a sparkling crystal grotto. With Clarissa, the "Marchen Reise" lamps to discover exciting places on the traces of the salt princess, in one or the other challenge to experience and surprise backgrounds on our early salt. / "Salz ist wertvoller als Gold und Edelsteine", behauptet Prinzessin Amelie im ARD-Marchen "Die Salzprinzessin". Aber stimmt das wirklich oder erzahlt sie nur Marchen? Hat es wirklich eine Zeit gegeben, in der Salz so wichtig war? Was hat es auf sich mit diesen kleinen, weiSSen Kornchen? Moderatorin Clarissa Correa da Silva begibt sich auf eine Marchenreise durch Deutschland: auf den Spuren der Salzprinzessin.Auf Schloss Buckeburg in Niedersachsen erfahrt sie in der Schlosskuche, warum Koche Salz super finden und weshalb Menschen ohne das so genannte "Pokeln" verhungert waren. Auf der weiteren Entdeckungstour staunt Clarissa daruber, dass Luneburg die Salzstadt des Nordens ist. Sie trifft dort Menschen, die ihr erklaren, warum Salz fruher "das weiSSe Gold" genannt wurde und weshalb die Stadt dadurch so reich geworden ist. Von Luneburg aus wurde Salz in die ganze Welt transportiert - aber wie? Die Antwort fuhrt Clarissa auf einen "Salz-Ewer", einen alten Holz-Kahn, mit dem sie uber den Fluss fahrt. Doch dabei gerat sie ganz schon ins Schwitzen, denn einen Motor gab es damals noch nicht und die Boots-Crew schont Clarissa nicht, wenn gegen die Stromung gefahren wird. SchlieSSlich bleibt fur Clarissa noch zu klaren: Wie kommt man eigentlich an Salz? Beim Besuch eines Salzsieders hat sie gut zu tun - denn sie will Luneburg naturlich nicht ohne Salz verlassen und muss lernen, aus Salzwasser Salz zu gewinnen. Clarissa fragt sich: Geht das auch anders? Und ja, das weiSSe Korn gibt es auch in Bergwerken, zum Beispiel in Thuringen. Hier erforscht Clarissa einen unfassbar langen Stollen in 800 Meter Tiefe und taucht ein in eine funkelnde Kristallgrotte.Zusammen mit Clarissa ladt die "Marchenreise" dazu ein, spannende Orte auf den Spuren der Salzprinzessin zu entdecken, bei der ein oder anderen Herausforderung mitzufiebern und uberraschende Hintergrunde uber das alltagliche Salz auf unserem Fruhstucksei zu erfahren.

programme.title: The show with the mouse special / Die Sendung mit der Maus Spezial
programme.desc: What are the consequences of shoplifting for young people? To find out that, "Maus" director Jan Marschner stages a fictional theft: Siham slips into the role of a young shoplike who steals a perfume bottle. In the "Mouse Special" it is shown which consequences Siham as a shopie can be expected and who decides on her punishment. As Siham is caught in her shop theft you play, she wonders what is going on. House ban in the business, that's for sure. But the actual anger is still coming: the police, public prosecutor, defense, judge and Schoffen, also the youth court assistance - they all play a role in history that Siham is now experiencing. Which punishment she gets depends on how Siham retention - and, whether she has stolen something several times. Anyone who is at least 14 years old can even come before a youth court. There Siham takes a seat on the dock and looks at how the consequences of "her crime" are decided. / Welche Folgen hat ein Ladendiebstahl fur Jugendliche? Um das herauszufinden, setzt "Maus"-Regisseur Jan Marschner einen fiktiven Diebstahl in Szene: Dafur schlupft Siham in die Rolle einer jungen Ladendiebin, die eine Parfumflasche klaut. Im "Maus Spezial" wird gezeigt, welche Konsequenzen Siham als Ladendiebin zu erwarten hat und wer uber ihre Strafe entscheidet.Als Siham bei ihrem gespielten Ladendiebstahl erwischt wird, fragt sie sich, was nun passiert. Hausverbot in dem Geschaft, das ist schon mal sicher. Aber der eigentliche Ärger kommt erst noch: Polizei, Staatsanwaltschaft, Verteidigung, Richter und Schoffen, auch die Jugendgerichtshilfe - sie alle spielen eine Rolle in der Geschichte, die Siham jetzt erlebt. Welche Strafe sie bekommt, hangt davon ab, wie Siham sich verhalt - und, ob sie schon mehrfach etwas geklaut hat. Jeder, der mindestens 14 Jahre alt ist, kann sogar vor ein Jugendgericht kommen. Dort nimmt Siham auf der Anklagebank Platz und sieht mit an, wie uber die Folgen "ihrer Straftat" entschieden wird.

programme.title: Thema Spezial
programme.sub-title: Live for school - what happened to the youngsters from back then? / Schule furs Leben - was wurde aus den Jugendlichen von damals?
programme.desc: In the 30-year-olds there was a unique experiment on the highlights. In 2014, Christoph Feurstein fought a class of the new middle school in Gassergasse in "School Furs", in which 98 percent of schoolmen have a migration background, with a class of the Rahlgasse high school in Vienna. Just three kilometers as the crow flies, the schools separate worlds. At that time, the young people learn from and together for half a year. A deep insight into the life of the families becomes possible and it shows what constructive learning often fails. Now for the 30-year shipping anniversary of questions of Christoph Feurstein and Jakob Egger, what has become of the young people from back then and whether something has changed in the school system. Andrea Walach, former school director in the new middle school Gassergasse, shocked in 2014 with the 2014 Statement that a third of their schoolmen became permanent customers at the labor market service and thus to social welfare recipients after the compulsory school has been completed. From home, these children hardly get any support because their parents get difficulties with different difficulties: poverty, unemployment, escape fate, problems to find their way in our society. The parents have a high level of education and the means of demanding their children next to school. According to the Matura, all the paths are open to the youngsters. At this school, Laura, Leonie, Julie, Dana and Arthur.Ilse Rolle accompanied the topic from the Rahlgasse Gymnasium, the rigid school system that does not allow mature learning and do not prepare the children for an increasingly complex world. What is your finding today? The timeless school series, which was broadcast weekly for half a year in 2014, has been awarded nationally and internationally (Pralat-Leopold-Hungar Prize, silver dolphin in Cannes) and has been highly praised by critics. / Im 30-jahrigen Bestehen von THEMA gehort ein einzigartiges Experiment zu den Highlights. 2014 fuhrt Christoph Feurstein in "Schule furs Leben" eine Klasse der Neuen Mittelschule Gassergasse, in der 98 Prozent der Schulerinnen und Schuler Migrationshintergrund haben, mit einer Klasse des Gymnasiums Rahlgasse in Wien zusammen. Nur drei Kilometer Luftlinie voneinander entfernt, trennen die Schulen Welten.Begleitet von funf Coaches lernen die Jugendlichen damals ein halbes Jahr lang von- und miteinander. Dabei wird ein tiefer Einblick in das Leben der Familien moglich und es zeigt sich, woran konstruktives Lernen oft scheitert.Jetzt zum 30-jahrigen Sendungsjubilaum von THEMA fragen Christoph Feurstein und Jakob Egger nach, was aus den jungen Menschen von damals geworden ist und ob sich im Schulsystem etwas zum Besseren verandert hat.Andrea Walach, ehemalige Schuldirektorin in der Neuen Mittelschule Gassergasse, schockiert 2014 mit der Aussage, ein Drittel ihrer Schulerinnen und Schuler wurde nach Abschluss der Pflichtschule zu Dauerkunden beim Arbeitsmarktservice und somit zu Sozialhilfeempfangern.Nabaa, Asip, Fatima und Sam sind vier jener Jugendlichen, deren Zukunft 2014 duster aussieht. Von zu Hause erhalten diese Kinder kaum Unterstutzung, weil ihre Eltern mit anderen Schwierigkeiten kampfen: Armut, Arbeitslosigkeit, Fluchtlingsschicksale, Probleme, sich in unserer Gesellschaft zurechtzufinden.Die Welt, in der Schuldirektorin Ilse Rollett am Wiener Gymnasium Rahlgasse mit ihren Schulerinnen und Schulern arbeitet, konnte unterschiedlicher nicht sein. Die Eltern haben ein hohes Bildungsbewusstsein und die Mittel, ihre Kinder neben der Schule zu fordern. Den Jugendlichen stehen nach der Matura alle Wege offen. An dieser Schule begleitet THEMA vor elf Jahren Laura, Leonie, Julie, Dana und Arthur.Ilse Rollet vom Gymnasium Rahlgasse kritisiert damals das starre Schulsystem, das facherubergreifendes Lernen nicht zulasse und die Kinder nicht auf eine immer komplexer werdende Welt vorbereite. Wie sieht ihr Befund heute aus?Die zeitlose Schulserie, die in THEMA 2014 ein halbes Jahr lang wochentlich ausgestrahlt wurde, ist national und international ausgezeichnet worden (Pralat- Leopold-Ungar-Preis, Silberner Delfin in Cannes) und ist von Kritikerinnen und Kritikern hoch gelobt worden.

programme.title: Thema Spezial
programme.sub-title: Live for school - what happened to the youngsters from back then? / Schule furs Leben - was wurde aus den Jugendlichen von damals?
programme.desc: In the 30-year-olds there was a unique experiment on the highlights. In 2014, Christoph Feurstein fought a class of the new middle school in Gassergasse in "School Furs", in which 98 percent of schoolmen have a migration background, with a class of the Rahlgasse high school in Vienna. Just three kilometers as the crow flies, the schools separate worlds. At that time, the young people learn from and together for half a year. A deep insight into the life of the families becomes possible and it shows what constructive learning often fails. Now for the 30-year shipping anniversary of questions of Christoph Feurstein and Jakob Egger, what has become of the young people from back then and whether something has changed in the school system. Andrea Walach, former school director in the new middle school Gassergasse, shocked in 2014 with the 2014 Statement that a third of their schoolmen became permanent customers at the labor market service and thus to social welfare recipients after the compulsory school has been completed. From home, these children hardly get any support because their parents get difficulties with different difficulties: poverty, unemployment, escape fate, problems to find their way in our society. The parents have a high level of education and the means of demanding their children next to school. According to the Matura, all the paths are open to the youngsters. At this school, Laura, Leonie, Julie, Dana and Arthur.Ilse Rolle accompanied the topic from the Rahlgasse Gymnasium, the rigid school system that does not allow mature learning and do not prepare the children for an increasingly complex world. What is your finding today? The timeless school series, which was broadcast weekly for half a year in 2014, has been awarded nationally and internationally (Pralat-Leopold-Hungar Prize, silver dolphin in Cannes) and has been highly praised by critics. / Im 30-jahrigen Bestehen von THEMA gehort ein einzigartiges Experiment zu den Highlights. 2014 fuhrt Christoph Feurstein in "Schule furs Leben" eine Klasse der Neuen Mittelschule Gassergasse, in der 98 Prozent der Schulerinnen und Schuler Migrationshintergrund haben, mit einer Klasse des Gymnasiums Rahlgasse in Wien zusammen. Nur drei Kilometer Luftlinie voneinander entfernt, trennen die Schulen Welten.Begleitet von funf Coaches lernen die Jugendlichen damals ein halbes Jahr lang von- und miteinander. Dabei wird ein tiefer Einblick in das Leben der Familien moglich und es zeigt sich, woran konstruktives Lernen oft scheitert.Jetzt zum 30-jahrigen Sendungsjubilaum von THEMA fragen Christoph Feurstein und Jakob Egger nach, was aus den jungen Menschen von damals geworden ist und ob sich im Schulsystem etwas zum Besseren verandert hat.Andrea Walach, ehemalige Schuldirektorin in der Neuen Mittelschule Gassergasse, schockiert 2014 mit der Aussage, ein Drittel ihrer Schulerinnen und Schuler wurde nach Abschluss der Pflichtschule zu Dauerkunden beim Arbeitsmarktservice und somit zu Sozialhilfeempfangern.Nabaa, Asip, Fatima und Sam sind vier jener Jugendlichen, deren Zukunft 2014 duster aussieht. Von zu Hause erhalten diese Kinder kaum Unterstutzung, weil ihre Eltern mit anderen Schwierigkeiten kampfen: Armut, Arbeitslosigkeit, Fluchtlingsschicksale, Probleme, sich in unserer Gesellschaft zurechtzufinden.Die Welt, in der Schuldirektorin Ilse Rollett am Wiener Gymnasium Rahlgasse mit ihren Schulerinnen und Schulern arbeitet, konnte unterschiedlicher nicht sein. Die Eltern haben ein hohes Bildungsbewusstsein und die Mittel, ihre Kinder neben der Schule zu fordern. Den Jugendlichen stehen nach der Matura alle Wege offen. An dieser Schule begleitet THEMA vor elf Jahren Laura, Leonie, Julie, Dana und Arthur.Ilse Rollet vom Gymnasium Rahlgasse kritisiert damals das starre Schulsystem, das facherubergreifendes Lernen nicht zulasse und die Kinder nicht auf eine immer komplexer werdende Welt vorbereite. Wie sieht ihr Befund heute aus?Die zeitlose Schulserie, die in THEMA 2014 ein halbes Jahr lang wochentlich ausgestrahlt wurde, ist national und international ausgezeichnet worden (Pralat- Leopold-Ungar-Preis, Silberner Delfin in Cannes) und ist von Kritikerinnen und Kritikern hoch gelobt worden.

programme.title: Report
programme.desc: Caught in the system - as Austria's judicial institutions at their borders are usually only an issue when prominent names are affected, whether Rene Benko, Karl -Heinz Grasser or Peter Hochegger. What does a system expect those who have to verify their punishment? With over 10,000 people in prison - as many than ever - the prisoners reach their limits: Protection institutions are overflowed, the staff at the limit. "Our colleagues are long overlooked, the situation is dramatic," warns the chairman of the judicial converter, Norbert Durnberger. People's prosecutor Gaby Schwarz also raises the alarm: "The condition in the prisoners are not allowed to be ignored for a long time." In order to relieve the detention centers, the government has launched an amendment to the electronic footpath. In art, more prisoners should get the possibility of settling their punishment in the kept house arrest. The report spoke to a person concerned who, from his everyday life with a footstage and in front of it in prison. Insight into a system between overwhelming, reform printing and new ways in prison. What is politics plans? Vanessa Bottcher and Laura Franz report. Wall protection in Austria - promised, but not kept? Femicide land Austria: How does effective violence protection fail? Violence against women often begins quietly, ends brutally too often and is no longer a margin. Violence protection is intended to save women from acute dangerous situations. But the current measures are not enough. The government is therefore working on a national action plan that is supposed to act against violence against violence - but will he keep what he promises? Alexandra Nobauer and Sabina Riedl have searched where the protection stays when it is most needed. In an interview with Eva Linsinger: Justice Minister Anna Sporrer -floppy pension splitting? 20 years ago, the so -called pension splitting was introduced, in which parents can split up the pension up to the age of 7. In 2024, only 1,600 couples made an application for it. In the same year, however, 77,000 children were born. Is pension splitting known too little, or is the instrument to be questioned? Sophie-Kristin Hausberger and Miriam Ressi have researched. / Gefangen im System - Wie Österreichs Justizanstalten an ihr Grenzen stoSSenJustizanstalten sind meist nur Thema, wenn prominente Namen betroffen sind, ob Rene Benko, Karl-Heinz Grasser oder Peter Hochegger. Was fur ein System erwartet jene, die ihre Strafe verbuSSen mussen? Mit uber 10.000 Menschen im Strafvollzug - so vielen wie nie zuvor - stoSSen die Gefangnisse an ihre Grenzen: Justizanstalten sind uberfullt, das Personal am Limit. "Unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind langst uberlastet, die Lage ist dramatisch", warnt der Vorsitzende der Justizwachegewerkschaft, Norbert Durnberger. Auch Volksanwaltin Gaby Schwarz schlagt Alarm: "Die Zustande in den Gefangnissen durfen nicht langer ignoriert werden." Um die Haftanstalten zu entlasten, hat die Regierung eine Novelle zur elektronischen FuSSfessel auf den Weg gebracht. Kunftig sollen mehr Haftlinge die Moglichkeit bekommen, ihre Strafe im uberwachten Hausarrest abzusitzen. Der Report hat mit einem Betroffenen gesprochen, der aus seinem Alltag mit FuSSfessel und davor im Gefangnis erzahlt. Einblicke in ein System zwischen Überforderung, Reformdruck und neuen Wegen im Strafvollzug. Was plant die Politik? Gewalt gegen Frauen beginnt oft leise, endet zu oft brutal und ist langst kein Randphanomen mehr. Der Gewaltschutz soll Frauen aus akuten Gefahrensituationen retten. Aber die derzeitigen MaSSnahmen reichen nicht aus. Die Regierung arbeitet deshalb an einem nationalen Aktionsplan, der ressortubergreifend gegen Gewalt an Frauen vorgehen soll - aber wird er halten, was er verspricht? Alexandra Nobauer und Sabina Riedl haben sich auf die Suche begeben, wo der Schutz bleibt, wenn er am dringendsten gebraucht wird.Dazu im Interview mit Eva Linsinger:Justizministerin Anna SporrerGeflopptes Pensionssplitting?Vor 20 Jahren ist das sogenannte Pensionssplitting eingefuhrt worden, bei dem Eltern bis zum 7. Lebensjahr ihres Kindes die Pensionsanspruche aufteilen konnen. 2024 haben nur 1.600 Paare einen Antrag dafur gestellt. Im selben Jahr sind allerdings 77.000 Kinder auf die Welt gekommen. Ist das Pensionssplitting zu wenig bekannt, oder ist das Instrument an sich zu hinterfragen? Sophie-Kristin Hausberger und Miriam Ressi haben recherchiert.

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Wachgekusst und neubelebt: Das Literaturhaus Vorarlberg - ein Ort reichhaltiger Geschichte
programme.desc: In April 2025, the Literaturhaus Vorarlberg in Villa Iwan and Franziska Rosenthal in Hohenems was opened. It is a special jewel: Open for everyone, it is a polyphonic, inclusive house of participation - a gray for language where literature can be experienced, heard, negotiated and continued. The documentation of the ORF Vorarlberg illuminates the history of the imposing basic time villa, which in 1890 fell into a thorn rosche sleep until it was kissed in the course of several years of restoration. Annette Raschner from ORF Vorarlberg accompanied the team in the first phase of development towards an open, future -oriented literary house with innovative offers. / Im April 2025 wurde das Literaturhaus Vorarlberg in der Villa Iwan und Franziska Rosenthal in Hohenems eroffnet. Es ist ein besonderes Juwel: Tagsuber offen fur alle, ist es ein vielstimmiges, inklusives Haus der Teilhabe - eine Buhne fur Sprache, wo Literatur live erlebt, gehort, verhandelt und weitergedacht werden kann. Die Dokumentation des ORF Vorarlberg beleuchtet die Historie der imposanten Grunderzeitvilla, die 1890 in einen Dornroschenschlaf gefallen war, bis sie im Zuge einer mehrjahrigen Restaurierung wachgekusst wurde. Annette Raschner vom ORF Vorarlberg hat das Team in der ersten Entwicklungsphase hin zu einem offenen, zukunftsweisenden Literaturhaus mit innovativen Angeboten begleitet.

programme.title: October 7 - The fate of unity 414 / 7. Oktober - das Schicksal von Einheit 414
programme.desc: On October 7th, it was two years ago that Hamas struck the Suden Israel and the bloodiest massacre in the history of the country: more than 1200 Israelis were died, 251 people were deported to the Gaza strip. Monitoring control center on the border with the Gaza Strip was in use and consistently consisted of young soldiers. These 22 young women were the first to notify and report the signs of the upcoming attack - and they also belong to the first victims of October 7th. Funfteen of them were totted and seven were delayed as hostages. The film shows original shots of the robbery and tries to combine with the survivors and their families, how the tragty could occur and why the warnings were not belonged. Design: David Korn-Brzoza, Michaël Darmon / Am 7. Oktober ist es zwei Jahre her, dass Terror-Kommandos der Hamas den Suden Israels uberfielen und das blutigste Massaker in der Geschichte des Landes verubten: mehr als 1200 Israelis wurden getotet, 251 Menschen als Geiseln in den Gazastreifen verschleppt.Das WELTjournal zeigt das Schicksal der Einheit 414 des Aufklarungskorps der israelischen Armee, das damals in einem Überwachungskontrollzentrum an der Grenze zum Gazastreifen im Einsatz war und uberwiegend aus jungen Soldatinnen bestand. Diese 22 jungen Frauen waren die Ersten, die die Anzeichen des bevorstehenden Angriffs bemerkten und meldeten - und sie gehorten auch zu den ersten Opfern des 7. Oktober. Funfzehn von ihnen wurden getotet und sieben als Geiseln verschleppt. Der Film zeigt Originalaufnahmen des Überfalls und versucht, mit den Überlebende und ihren Familien zu ergrunden, wie es zu der Tragodie kommen konnte und warum die Warnungen nicht gehort wurden.Gestaltung: David Korn-Brzoza, Michaël Darmon

programme.title: Israel and Palastina - two Volker, one country / Israel und Palastina - zwei Volker, ein Land
programme.desc: Angesichts der Eskalation nach dem 7. Oktober und dem Krieg in Gaza schwinden die letzten Hoffnungen auf ein Zusammenleben zwischen Israelis und Palastinensern. Die Anerkennung von Palastina als Staat durch den GroSSteil der internationalen Staatengemeinschaft ist zwar ein groSSer symbolischer Schritt, die seit Jahrzehnten angestrebte Zweistaatenlosung gilt aber als immer unwahrscheinlicher.Das Weltjournal+ zeigt, wie verfahren jede Suche nach einer diplomatischen Losung ist. Israel hat im Lauf der Jahre in den drei Palastinensergebiete scheinbar unumkehrbare Fakten geschaffen: im annektierten Ost-Jerusalem und im besetzten West-Jordanland wird immer mehr Land vereinnahmt und der israelische Siedlungsbau laufend ausgeweitet, fur den Gazastreifen ist offenbar ebenfalls Besatzung und israelische Besiedelung geplant. Likud-Politiker und Siedler Amir Weitmann hat bereits einen detaillierten Plan zur Absiedlung der palastinensischen Bevolkerung ausgearbeitet. Zu Wort kommen politische Fuhrer und Aktivisten und Aktivistinnen beider Seiten.Gestaltung: Isabelle Ducret, Yannick Tenet
