programme.title: Table tennis Bundesliga women: Stockerau - Tulln, highlights from Stockerau / Tischtennis Bundesliga Damen: Stockerau - Tulln, Highlights aus Stockerau
programme.desc: For Christmas, the European Table Tennis Association of the Portuguese capital Lisbon brought the 33rd Team European Championship. 32 teams for men and 33 The women will find themselves in the Meo Arena Lisbons and get in rapid and gripping matches around the team crown of Europe. As the defending champion, Germany goes into the race, which won a total of four of the six fashioned gold medals at the last team European Championship in Schwechat and thus won the title. In addition, the players of the DTTB never cut off worse than third. Eurosport transfers the three decisive competition days of the table tennis team European Championship. / Zu Weihnachten bescherte der Europaische Tischtennisverband der Portugiesischen Hauptstadt Lissabon die Austragung der 33. Team-EM. 32 Teams bei den Herren und 33 bei den Damen werden sich in der MEO Arena Lissabons einfinden und in rasanten und packenden Matches um die Team-Krone Europas kampfen. Als Titelverteidiger geht Deutschland in das Rennen, die bei der letzten Team-EM in Schwechat insgesamt vier der sechs moglichen Goldmedaillen gewannen und so den Titel holten. Zudem schnitten die Spielerinnen und Spieler des DTTB nie schlechter als Rang drei ab. Eurosport ubertragt die drei entscheidenden Wettkampftage der Tischtennis Team-EM LIVE.

programme.title: The PS professionals - more power from the pot / Die PS-Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott
programme.sub-title: HotRod mit Stargast Alex Wesselsky, Kurzversion
programme.desc: From now on, Jean Pierre and Sidney put a good mood at the Autocheck again: Even in the new season of "The PS professionals-More Power from the Pott" The Ruhrpott duo in each shipment will find the order of Sport1 viewers to find a suitable used one. They give tips and tricks, call the specific weaknesses of individual models, reveal the tricks of the seller and show how to buy good used cars for little money. / Jean Pierre und Sidney machen ab sofort wieder gute Laune beim Autocheck: Auch in der neuen Staffel von "Die PS PROFIS - mehr Power aus dem Pott" erhalt das Ruhrpott-Duo in jeder Sendung den Auftrag von SPORT1-Zuschauern, einen passenden Gebrauchten zu finden. Dabei geben sie Tipps und Tricks, nennen die spezifischen Schwachstellen einzelner Modelle, verraten die Kniffe der Verkaufer und zeigen, wie man fur wenig Geld gute gebrauchte Autos kaufen kann.

programme.title: Dogs out of control - a coach for all skins / Hunde auSSer Kontrolle - Ein Coach fur alle Felle

programme.title: Darts Party
programme.desc: "Darts Party" is anything but an ordinary tournament. 24 participants compete against each other in a competition lasting several weeks. Every week, six groups around the finals cattle up to the final - among other things on rotating platforms, slippery soil or in front of flying barriers. Only when these obstacles are overwound can be targeted on the board. Prazision, concentration and athletics are in demand - and deliver the best entertainment. At the end of the week, the four day winners meet in a tense weekly finals - only one makes the leap into the big series finale. / "Darts Party" ist alles andere als ein gewohnliches Turnier. 24 Teilnehmende treten in einem mehrwochigen Wettbewerb gegeneinander an. Jede Woche kampfen Sechsergruppen um den Einzug ins Finale - unter anderem auf drehenden Plattformen, rutschigen Boden oder vor fliegenden Barrieren. Erst wenn diese Hindernisse uberwunden sind, darf aufs Board gezielt werden. Prazision, Konzentration und Athletik sind gefragt - und liefern beste Unterhaltung. Am Ende der Woche treffen die vier Tagessieger in einem spannungsgeladenen Wochenfinale aufeinander - nur einer schafft den Sprung ins groSSe Serienfinale.

programme.title: Dogs out of control - a coach for all skins / Hunde auSSer Kontrolle - Ein Coach fur alle Felle
programme.desc: Great Britain is a nation of dog lovers - but what happens when the homely Gluck flaps into chaos? There is someone for the luck that you can call. His motto is clear: "Every dog, every age, every problem." / GroSSbritannien ist eine Nation von Hundeliebhabern - doch was passiert, wenn das hausliche Gluck ins Chaos umschlagt? Meisterhundetrainer Graeme Hall ist auf einer Mission, wieder Harmonie herzustellen, und hat sich mit uber zehn Jahren Erfahrung einen Namen damit gemacht, schnelle, aber nachhaltige Losungen fur nahezu jedes Hundeproblem zu finden. Sein Motto ist klar: "Jeder Hund, jedes Alter, jedes Problem."

programme.title: Darts Party
programme.desc: "Darts Party" is anything but an ordinary tournament. 24 participants compete against each other in a competition lasting several weeks. Every week, six groups around the finals cattle up to the final - among other things on rotating platforms, slippery soil or in front of flying barriers. Only when these obstacles are overwound can be targeted on the board. Prazision, concentration and athletics are in demand - and deliver the best entertainment. At the end of the week, the four day winners meet in a tense weekly finals - only one makes the leap into the big series finale. / "Darts Party" ist alles andere als ein gewohnliches Turnier. 24 Teilnehmende treten in einem mehrwochigen Wettbewerb gegeneinander an. Jede Woche kampfen Sechsergruppen um den Einzug ins Finale - unter anderem auf drehenden Plattformen, rutschigen Boden oder vor fliegenden Barrieren. Erst wenn diese Hindernisse uberwunden sind, darf aufs Board gezielt werden. Prazision, Konzentration und Athletik sind gefragt - und liefern beste Unterhaltung. Am Ende der Woche treffen die vier Tagessieger in einem spannungsgeladenen Wochenfinale aufeinander - nur einer schafft den Sprung ins groSSe Serienfinale.

programme.title: Fruhling
programme.desc: Mark causes a serious accident with a horse. The young rider Charlotte then obliges the vet to maintain her stallion again. It seems to hate the animal. Mark suggests that the stallion for the duration of the treatment at home. Luisa Gossner's hate is founded that her husband died a year earlier in an accident with Henry and she blames the horse. Mark does not prevent this from sacrificing Henry with Filippa's support, who himself suffers the rejection of his owner. When Mark finds out by chance that Luisa gives himself a complicity in the accident of her husband, he realizes that it could be important for people and horse to find each other again. Schneiderhahn, who has now become a friend for Katja. Schneiderhahn's mother Elisa has a brain tumor and not long to live. When caring for the old woman, Katja learns from her last wish: she wants to go to the "elbow" again on the island of Sylt, the northernmost spot in Germany. With this place, Elisa's memories combine her late husband, her great love - and in delightful family times. Katja and Dr. Schneiderhahn hecken together to explain Elisa her last wish. With Professor Gabriel's support, they organize an ambulance and crew and set off together with the old lady and pastor Sonnleitner. / Mark verursacht einen folgenschweren Unfall mit einem Pferd. Die junge Reiterin Charlotte verpflichtet den Tierarzt daraufhin, ihren Hengst wieder gesund zu pflegen.Brisanz hat die Bitte des Madchens, weil Charlottes Mutter Luisa aus unerfindlichem Grund gegen eine Behandlung des Pferdes ist. Sie scheint das Tier geradezu zu hassen. Mark schlagt vor, den Hengst fur die Dauer der Behandlung bei sich zu Hause aufzunehmen.Luisa Gossners Hass liegt darin begrundet, dass ihr Mann ein Jahr zuvor bei einem Unfall mit dem Hengst Henry ums Leben kam und sie dem Pferd die Schuld daran gibt. Mark hindert das nicht, sich mit Filippas Unterstutzung aufopfernd um Henry zu kummern, der selbst die Ablehnung seiner Besitzerin spurt und darunter leidet. Als Mark durch Zufall erfahrt, dass Luisa sich durchaus selbst eine Mitschuld am Unfall ihres Mannes gibt, wird ihm klar, dass es fur Mensch und Pferd wichtig sein konnte, wieder zueinanderzufinden.Wahrenddessen unterstutzt Katja die Ärztin Dr. Schneiderhahn, die inzwischen fur Katja zu einer Freundin geworden ist. Schneiderhahns Mutter Elisa hat einen Hirntumor und nicht mehr lange zu leben. Bei der Pflege der alten Frau erfahrt Katja von deren letztem Wunsch: Sie will noch einmal an den "Ellenbogen" auf der Insel Sylt, dem nordlichsten Fleck Deutschlands. Mit diesem Ort verbinden sich Erinnerungen Elisas an ihren verstorbenen Mann, ihre groSSe Liebe - und an gluckliche Familienzeiten.Katja und Dr. Schneiderhahn hecken gemeinsam einen Plan aus, um Elisa ihren letzten Wunsch zu erfullen. Mit Professor Gabriels Unterstutzung organisieren sie einen Rettungswagen samt Besatzung und machen sich gemeinsam mit der alten Dame sowie Pfarrer Sonnleitner auf den Weg ans Meer.

programme.title: Backstage - Die Ehrlich Brothers
programme.desc: The documentary "Backstage: The Ehrlich Brothers - The Magic behind the Diamonds Show" looks exclusively behind the scenes of the gigantic event in the Westfalenhalle. The documentary shows the cobie Andreas and Chris plan their magic tricks and their show, as the dentrads interlock behind the gray: from the management and the mask to the groybling. Plan, prepare and implement magic places. "The bigest Gluck that we have is that your own brother is still at the side. A solo career, even if you were successful, I cannot imagine because it would be worthless, because time in pairs is the highest," says Chris. Is that really like that? The documentation shows how big the brother love is, whether Andreas and Chris get along well, how often they argue or agree. And speaks to the bruders about their blackest moments in their professional life, the greatest jerking of her career, about the role of her late father and his influence on her magic tricks. In Dortmund, 350 people work almost continuously for a week to realize the huge "Diamonds" show. 39 cameras are in use, two extra trucks fully loaded with pyrotechnics. And then: Andreas's rehearsal accident, who comes too close to a pyro effect in the "wrong moment" and whose hair is suddenly in flames. Is the big anniversary show dangerous? / Die Doku "Backstage: Die Ehrlich Brothers - Die Magie hinter der Diamonds-Show" schaut exklusiv hinter die Kulissen der gigantischen Veranstaltung in der Westfalenhalle.Immer nah dran an den Brudern, ihrem Team und der Crew. Die Doku zeigt, mit welcher Akribie Andreas und Chris ihre Zaubertricks und ihre Show planen, wie die Zahnrader hinter der Buhne ineinandergreifen: vom Management uber die Maske bis zum Buhnenaufbau.Sie verrat, was der Motor ihrer Zauber-Leidenschaft ist.Das "Backstage-Team" begleitet erstmals Andreas und Chris in ihre "heiligen Hallen" in Bunde, wo die Ehrlich Brothers zwischen Natur und Tieren ihre unglaublichen Zauberkunststucke planen, vorbereiten und umsetzen. "Das groSSte Gluck, das wir haben, ist, dass der eigene Bruder standig an der Seite ist. Eine Solokarriere, auch wenn sie erfolgreich ware, kann ich mir nicht vorstellen, weil sie wertlos ware, denn die Zeit zu zweit ist das hochste Gut", sagt Chris. Ist das wirklich so?Die Dokumentation zeigt, wie groSS die Bruderliebe ist, ob sich Andreas und Chris gut vertragen, wie oft sie streiten oder einer Meinung sind. Und spricht mit den Brudern auch uber ihre schwarzesten Momente ihres Berufslebens, den groSSten Ruckschlag ihrer Karriere, uber die Rolle ihres verstorbenen Vaters und seinen Einfluss auf ihre Zaubertricks.In Dortmund arbeiten 350 Menschen eine Woche lang nahezu ununterbrochen, um die gewaltige "Diamonds"-Show zu realisieren. 39 Kameras sind im Einsatz, zwei Extra-Trucks voll beladen mit Pyrotechnik. Und dann: der Proben-Unfall von Andreas, der im "falschen Moment" zu nah an einen Pyro-Effekt kommt und dessen Haare plotzlich in Flammen stehen. Ist die groSSe Jubilaums-Show gefahrdet?

programme.title: The kiosk: coffee, beer and emotions / Der Kiosk: Kaffee, Bier und Emotionen
programme.desc: The kiosk around the corner - for many a stucco home. But in economically difficult times, more and more kiosks have to close. How can your operators keep you running? Lateral entrants Serdar (28) took over a spati in Berlin-Kreuzberg in the spring 2025. In the Ruhr area, Naciye (46) has been running the "Ballerbude" since 2015. Both want to bind their regular customers - and win new ones. As Serdar saw the chance to take the Spati at the ViktoriaPark in Berlin -Kreuzberg, he quickly increased. Now the former distributor stands behind the counter almost every day and tried something new: How can he coordinate his offer to the customers in the trendy district? What attractions can he offer to make his spati special? The newly baked family man is supported by his brother Emre (26). With a lot of effort and heart, the two control the spati through the first summer. Serdar succeeds in building up an existence? In 2015, Naciye (46) stood for the first time behind the counter of the "Ballerbude" in Oer-Erkenschwick. A lot has happened since then: in the shop she met her second husband Kamil, raised her son Selçuk and Orçun and built up a loyal clientele with her open and warm manner. But even though you are buzzing, she has to stretch. Inflation and price increases do not only hit their ground customers on their wallets. She can only keep her comparatively low prices with muhe - but it is precisely these that bring the day -to -day visitors. If Naciye succeeds with the support of her family to drive her neighborhood meeting into the future? In alternative from capital to Ruhrpott, "37 °" shows a panorama of German kiosk culture between the trend and tradition. Careful, but directly, the film captures the atmosphere: without make -up, authentic and close to people, for which the kiosk means more than the opportunity for a quick purchase. Real life takes place here - sometimes funny, sometimes hard, always true. Kioske - in NRW "drinking halls" or "Budchen", in Berlin "Spatis", in Frankfurt "Wasserhauschen" - no longer a self -evident part of the cityscape. If there were 44,000 ten years ago, experts today are schat on 24,000. The reason: competitive pressure through discounters with long opening times, lack of staff and price increases. A stucco neighborhood threatens to die out. / Der Kiosk um die Ecke - fur viele ein Stuck Heimat. Doch in wirtschaftlich schwierigen Zeiten mussen immer mehr Kioske schlieSSen. Wie konnen ihre Betreiber sie am Laufen halten?Quereinsteiger Serdar (28) hat im Fruhling 2025 einen Spati in Berlin-Kreuzberg ubernommen. Im Ruhrgebiet fuhrt Naciye (46) seit 2015 die "Ballerbude". Beide wollen ihre Stammkunden binden - und neue dazu gewinnen.Als Serdar die Chance sah, den Spati am Viktoriapark in Berlin-Kreuzberg zu ubernehmen, griff er kurzerhand zu. Jetzt steht der ehemalige Vertriebler fast jeden Tag hinterm Tresen und probiert standig Neues: Wie kann er sein Angebot auf die Kundschaft im Szeneviertel abstimmen? Welche Attraktionen kann er bieten, um seinen Spati besonders zu machen? Unterstutzt wird der frischgebackene Familienvater von seinem Bruder Emre (26). Mit viel Einsatz und Herz steuern die beiden den Spati durch den ersten Sommer. Gelingt es Serdar, sich damit eine Existenz aufzubauen?2015 stand Naciye (46) zum ersten Mal hinterm Tresen der "Ballerbude" in Oer-Erkenschwick. Seitdem hat sich viel getan: In dem Laden hat sie ihren zweiten Ehemann Kamil kennengelernt, ihre Sohne Selçuk und Orçun groSSgezogen und sich mit ihrer offenen und warmherzigen Art eine treue Kundschaft aufgebaut. Doch obwohl ihr Budchen brummt, muss sie sich strecken. Inflation und Preissteigerungen schlagen nicht nur ihrer bodenstandigen Stammkundschaft auf den Geldbeutel. Ihre vergleichsweise niedrigen Preise kann sie nur mit Muhe halten - doch gerade diese bringen die taglichen Besucher. Gelingt es Naciye, mit der Unterstutzung ihrer Familie, ihren Nachbarschaftstreff in die Zukunft zu fuhren?Im Wechsel von Hauptstadt zu Ruhrpott zeigt "37°" ein Panorama deutscher Kiosk-Kultur zwischen Trend und Tradition. Behutsam, aber direkt, fangt der Film die Atmosphare ein: Ungeschminkt, authentisch und nah den Menschen, fur die der Kiosk mehr bedeutet als die Gelegenheit fur einen schnellen Einkauf. Hier findet das echte Leben statt - mal lustig, mal hart, immer wahrhaftig.Langst sind Kioske - in NRW "Trinkhallen" oder "Budchen", in Berlin "Spatis", in Frankfurt "Wasserhauschen" - kein selbstverstandlicher Teil des Stadtbildes mehr. Gab es vor zehn Jahren noch 44.000, schatzen Experten die Zahl heute auf 24.000. Die Grunde: Konkurrenzdruck durch Discounter mit langen Öffnungszeiten, Personalmangel und Preissteigerungen. Ein Stuck Nachbarschaft droht auszusterben.

Zwei neue Anbieter liefern je eine Woche lang frisch gekochtes Essen - und die Kinder durfen mitentscheiden, wer kunftig die Schule beliefern soll. Bewertet werden Geschmack, Aussehen, Vielfalt - und naturlich: Was bleibt auf dem Teller?Als endlich auch der Umzug in die neue Mensa ansteht, helfen alle mit: Eltern, Kinder, Lehrkrafte. Es wird geschleppt, dekoriert, geputzt - und zum ersten Mal entsteht ein Ort, an dem essen mehr ist als nur satt zu werden.Beim groSSen Wiedersehen mit Sebastian Lege zeigt sich: Es ist wirklich etwas passiert. Der Schulgarten gedeiht. Die Kinder wissen, wo ihr Gemuse herkommt. Der neue Caterer liefert frisch, gesund und lecker. Die neue Mensa ist lebendig und einladend.Und vielleicht das Schonste: Aus skeptischen Essern sind neugierige Geschmackshelden und Geschmacksheldinnen geworden.

programme.title: Agency, annoyance and freedom - where are we in the east? / Einigkeit, Verdruss und Freiheit - Wo stehen wir im Osten?
programme.desc: On October 3, 1990, two German states became Germany. Everything was different for the people from the GDR. Little for the people in the West. How are we united today? The annoyance in the country, the dissatisfaction, seem to be gaining weight - especially in the east. But what are the reason for that? How do people look today, 35 years after reunification, their home, their life and the "system" Federal Republic? Birgit Warnke's film is looking for traces and sprints in the east - for example at a pub evening in the small Thuringian village of Niederbosa. The AfD recently won more than 60 percent. Where does dissatisfaction come from in the idyllic 130-soul community? Or at the nationwide largest Simson meeting in Zwickau, which attracts many young men, who celebrate their GDR cult mopeds and their East German identity for four days. The Doku also has the history of Petra Peterhansel, which has done its training at Wartburg in the VEB Automobilwerk Eisenach and is now heading the BMW plant in Leipzig. She is one of the few East Germans that made it into a top position. Just one exception? Why are East German in the East Germans still underrapsed in the East German in Fuhrung? And what did it do with the east that the population has shrunk by 15 percent since 1990 and so many people migrated to the West? He is the front man of the punk band "Feine Sahne Fischfilet", who is committed to right -wing radicalism. "Monchi" was born in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, there would be no option to go to the West. The documentary accompanies him on his "Wasted in Jarmen" festival with which he and his band liked to look at what connects and not to what separates. For "Monchi", political differences are not necessarily east -west, but above all a question from the city and country. And then there are the former NVA officers who are still meeting regularly today and exchanged about reunification - as it has run. Also because they had imagined their lives very differently. For a long time, they no longer have everything to say - especially when it comes to their view of Russia, which is fundamentally different from the majority opinion. How do different experiences, perspectives and identities? In the film, prominent East Germans - like actress Christiane Paul, the political legend Gregor Gysi, sociologist Steffen Mau, director Christian Schwochow and journalist Valerie Schonian. / Am 3. Oktober 1990 wurde aus zwei deutschen Staaten ein Deutschland. Fur die Menschen aus der DDR anderte sich alles. Fur die Menschen im Westen nur wenig. Wie vereint sind wir heute?Der Verdruss im Land, die Unzufriedenheit, scheinen zuzunehmen - vor allem im Osten. Aber was sind dafur die Grunde? Wie blicken die Menschen heute, 35 Jahre nach der Wiedervereinigung, auf ihre Heimat, ihr Leben und das "System" Bundesrepublik?Der Film von Birgit Warnke geht auf Spurensuche und spurt den Stimmungen im Osten nach - etwa bei einem Kneipenabend in dem kleinen thuringischen Dorf Niederbosa. Dort haben mehr als 60 Prozent zuletzt die AfD gewahlt. Woher kommt die Unzufriedenheit in der idyllischen 130-Seelengemeinde? Oder bei dem bundesweit groSSten Simsontreffen in Zwickau, das vor allem viele junge Manner anzieht, die vier Tage ihre DDR-Kult-Mopeds und ihre ostdeutsche Identitat feiern.Die Doku erzahlt auch die Geschichte von Petra Peterhansel, die in der DDR im VEB Automobilwerk Eisenach ihre Ausbildung bei Wartburg gemacht hat und mittlerweile das BMW-Werk in Leipzig leitet. Sie ist eine der wenigen Ostdeutschen, die es in eine Spitzenposition geschafft hat. Nur eine Ausnahme?Warum sind 35 Jahre nach der Einheit Ostdeutsche in Fuhrung immer noch so unterreprasentiert? Und was hat es mit dem Osten gemacht, dass die Bevolkerung seit 1990 um 15 Prozent geschrumpft ist und so viele Menschen in den Westen abgewandert sind?Immer im Osten geblieben ist Jan "Monchi" Gorkow. Er ist Frontmann der Punkband "Feine Sahne Fischfilet", die sich gegen Rechtsradikalismus engagiert. "Monchi" ist in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern geboren, fur ihn ware es keine Option in den Westen zu gehen. Die Doku begleitet ihn auf sein "Wasted in Jarmen"-Festival mit dem er und seine Band auf das schauen mochten, was verbindet und nicht auf das, was trennt. Fur "Monchi" sind politische Unterschiede nicht unbedingt Ost-West Unterschiede, sondern vor allem eine Frage von Stadt und Land.Und dann sind da noch die ehemaligen NVA-Offiziere, die sich heute noch regelmaSSig treffen und uber die Wiedervereinigung - so wie sie gelaufen ist - enttauscht sind. Auch, weil sie sich ihren Lebensweg ganz anders vorgestellt hatten. Langst haben sie das Gefuhl nicht mehr alles sagen zu durfen - vor allem, wenn es um ihren Blick auf Russland geht, der sich von der Mehrheitsmeinung fundamental unterscheidet. Wie pragen unterschiedliche Erfahrungen, Sichtweisen und Identitaten?Davon erzahlen im Film auch prominente Ostdeutsche - wie die Schauspielerin Christiane Paul, die Politlegende Gregor Gysi, der Soziologe Steffen Mau, der Regisseur Christian Schwochow und die Journalistin Valerie Schonian.

In fact, the Rauber Hotzenplotz lurks the boys, robs the box and leaves a sand lane when fleeing. The Rauber smelled female, discovered the two pursuers and captures them. Since Kasperl and Seppel have swapped the caps, Hotzenplotz believes that the cheeky Kasperl is Seppel. Annoyed by his chatter, he exchanges him against snuff about snuff with magician Petrosilius Zwackelmann. Now the poor Kasperl has to shell the whole day for Zwackelmann. Layed in chains, he is supposed to bring the grubby Rauberhohle up to scratch. In order to increase the loose money, the Rauber even escaped the grandmother into his hollow. First the stolen coffee room, then two of the boys and now also the grandmother. Maybe the widow Schlotterbeck can help him. She is in possession of a crystal ball with which she can clairvoyance. In the meantime, Wizard Zwackelmann's castle makes Kasperl the acquaintance of a unkeous caught in the basement, which is actually the enchanted fairy amaryllis. And the fairy has a plan of how to put both the Rauber Hotzenplotz and the magician Zwackelmann the craft. To do this, Kasperl must first be able to flee out of the castle to get the fairy cabbage. This is the only way to be possible to get Fee Amaryllis out of their unique existence. Only then is the fairy able to stand up to the Zwackelmann with its own magic powers. Kasperl is facing an exciting mission: in the middle of the night, persecuted by the raging magician Zwackelmann on his flying coat, he goes on the long path to the high heath. He has a strutable beard, seven knives and a flap with three splendor. Generations of children love him, now he has finally broken up to a new raid: the Rauber Hotzenplotz. For the title role of the movie, the Esterreichische Burgtheater star Nicholas ofczarek ("Der Pass") was hired, which brought one of Otfried Preussler's most popular children's book figures. After the big cinema sequences of "Die Kleine Hexe", "Heidi", "The Little Ghost" and "Krabat", the Claussen+Putz Filmproduktion brought another classic of children's and youth literature onto the big canvas. / Als der Rauber Hotzenplotz der GroSSmutter die Kaffeemuhle klaut, glauben Kasperl und Seppel nicht, dass Wachtmeister Dimpfelmoser den Fall lost. Sie nehmen die Sache selbst in die Hand.Um den Rauber aufzuspuren, bohren Kasperl und Seppel ein Loch in eine Kiste voller Sand und schreiben "Vorsicht, kein Gold" darauf. Tatsachlich lauert der Rauber Hotzenplotz den Buben auf, raubt die Kiste und hinterlasst bei der Flucht eine Sandspur.Kasperl und Seppel mussen nun nur noch der Spur folgen, die sie geradewegs zum Versteck des Rauber Hotzenplotz fuhrt. Unglucklicherweise hat der Rauber Lunte gerochen, entdeckt die beiden Verfolger und nimmt sie gefangen. Da Kasperl und Seppel die Mutzen vertauscht haben, glaubt Hotzenplotz, es handele sich beim vorlauten Kasperl um Seppel. Genervt von dessen Geplapper tauscht er ihn beim Zauberer Petrosilius Zwackelmann gegen Schnupftabak ein. Nun muss der arme Kasperl den ganzen Tag fur Zwackelmann Kartoffeln schalen.Dem armen Seppel alias Kasperl geht es beim Hotzenplotz auch nicht besser. In Ketten gelegt soll er die schmuddelige Rauberhohle auf Vordermann bringen. Um das Losegeld zu erhohen, entfuhrt der Rauber sogar noch die GroSSmutter in seine Hohle.Wachtmeister Dimpfelmoser weiSS mittlerweile nicht mehr, wo ihm der Kopf steht. Erst die geklaute Kaffeemuhle, dann zwei entfuhrte Buben und jetzt auch noch die GroSSmutter. Vielleicht kann ihm die Witwe Schlotterbeck helfen. Sie ist im Besitz einer Kristallkugel, mit deren Hilfe sie hellsehen kann.In Zauberer Zwackelmanns Burg macht Kasperl derweil die Bekanntschaft einer im Keller gefangen gehaltenen Unke, die in Wirklichkeit die verzauberte Fee Amaryllis ist. Und die Fee hat einen Plan, wie man sowohl dem Rauber Hotzenplotz als auch dem Zauberer Zwackelmann das Handwerk legen kann. Dazu muss Kasperl es allerdings zunachst schaffen, aus der Burg zu fliehen, um das Feenkraut zu besorgen. Nur damit ist es moglich, Fee Amaryllis aus ihrem Unken-Dasein zu erlosen. Erst dann ist die Fee in der Lage, mit ihren eigenen Zauberkraften dem Zwackelmann Paroli zu bieten.Kasperl steht eine aufregende Mission bevor: Mitten in der Nacht, verfolgt vom tobsuchtigen Zauberer Zwackelmann auf seinem fliegenden Mantel, macht er sich auf den langen Weg zur Hohen Heide, um das Feenkraut zu finden.Er hat einen struppigen Bart, sieben Messer und einen Schlapphut mit drei prachtigen Federn. Generationen von Kindern lieben ihn, nun ist er endlich zu einem neuen Raubzug aufgebrochen: der Rauber Hotzenplotz. Fur die Titelrolle des Kinofilms konnte der osterreichische Burgtheater-Star Nicholas Ofczarek ("Der Pass") verpflichtet werden, der eine der beliebtesten Kinderbuchfiguren von Otfried PreuSSler zu neuem Leben erweckt. Nach den groSSen Kinoerfolgen von "Die kleine Hexe", "Heidi", "Das kleine Gespenst" und "Krabat" hat die Claussen+Putz Filmproduktion einen weiteren Klassiker der Kinder- und Jugendliteratur auf die groSSe Leinwand gebracht.

programme.title: Racing on the Edge

programme.desc: Euroleague. Description: S. Dimolitsa / Euroleague. Η Βίρτους Μπολόνια, που πέρσι είχε δύσκολη σεζόν και τερμάτισε στη 17η θέση, ξεκινά τη φετινή EuroLeague κόντρα στη Ρεάλ Μαδρίτης, που την περασμένη σεζόν αποκλείστηκε στη φάση των πλέι οφ από τον Ολυμπιακό. Περιγραφή: Σ. Δημολίτσας

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: PSG vs Auxerre - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 6 - Mini match
programme.desc: Paris SG are the team Auxerre has played and lost against most often in Ligue 1. AJA have lost 10 of their 14 away matches against PSG in the top-flight in the 21st century. Despite having the same number of points and goal difference as Monaco, Paris SG is currently second in Ligue 1 2025/26. This is only the fourth time in the last 11 seasons that PSG are not in the lead after five matches played, after 2016/17, 2020/21 and 2023/24.

programme.title: Atletico de Madrid vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 7 -Mini Match
programme.desc: Atletico de Madrid have not lost any of their last five matches against Real Madrid in LaLiga and could equal their best ever run without defeat against Los Blancos in the competition, achieved in February 2016, also under Diego Simeone. Real Madrid have lost two of their last four LaLiga away games against Atletico de Madrid, after suffering only one defeat in their previous 20 visits to Rojiblancos ground in the competition.

programme.title: Barcelona vs Real Sociedad - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 7 -Mini Match
programme.desc: Barcelona have lost two of their last five matches against Real Sociedad in LaLiga, twice as many defeats as in their previous 16 encounters with the San Sebastian side in the top-flight. Real Sociedad have lost 26 of their last 27 visits to Barcelona in LaLiga, with the only exception in this run being their 2-1 win in May 2023. They have suffered 67 away defeats against the Azulgranas in their history in the competition, at least 11 more than against any other opponent.

programme.title: PFC Nasaf (UZB) vs Al Hilal SFC (KSA) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - West MD2
programme.desc: This will be the first fixture in AFC Champions League Elite between Nasaf and Al-Hilal, Nasaf have won just one of their eight games against teams from Saudi Arabia in the competition and are winless in their last four such games. Al-Hilal have lost just one of their 14 group stage games against teams from Uzbekistan in AFC Champions League Elite history, a 1-2 loss to FK Mash’al Mubarek in 2006; they have scored in each of their 14 such games in the competition, scoring at least twice in 11 of these.

programme.title: Al Gharafa SC (Qat) vs Al Shorta (IRQ) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - West MD2 / Al Gharafa SC (QAT) vs Al Shorta (IRQ) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - West MD2
programme.desc: This will be the first meeting between Al Gharafa and Al Shorta in the AFC Champions League Elite; Al Gharafa is winless in their two encounters against Iraqi sides in the competition while Al Shorta is unbeaten in their last two games against Qatari sides. Al Gharafa won their most recent home game in the AFC Champions League Elite, the last time they won back-to-back home games in the competition was a run of three games between May 2012 and April 2013; they kept a clean sheet in their previous home game, they have never recorded back-to-back clean sheets at home in the competition.

programme.title: Al Duhail SC (QAT) vs Al Ahli Saudi FC (KSA) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - West MD2
programme.desc: Al Duhail have won only one of their previous four AFC Champions League Elite games against Al-Ahli, however, this win did come in their only home game in the competition against the Saudi Arabia team. Al Duhail lost their opening game of AFC Champions League Elite 2025-26 1-2 against Al-Hilal; they have lost each of their last four games against teams from Saudi Arabia in the competition, conceding a total of 16 goals in these games.

programme.title: Kairat Almaty vs Real Madrid - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: Kairat’s game against Real Madrid will be the just the second fixture played between sides from Kazakhstan and Spain in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League, after Astana’s meetings with Atletico Madrid in the 2015-16 group stage. Real Madrid have only lost three of the last 30 instances when facing a team for the first time in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League, suffering defeats against Lille in 2024, Sheriff Tiraspol in 2021 and Wolfsburg in 2016.

programme.title: Galatasaray vs Liverpool - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: Galatasaray and Liverpool will meet for a fifth time in European competition, with both sides managing one victory apiece across the previous four. This will be their first game against each other since a 3-2 win for Galatasaray in the UEFA Champions League in December 2006. Liverpool are winless in their previous two away trips to face Galatasaray, 1-1 in February 2002 and losing 3-2 in December 2006. The only teams they’ve faced away from home more often in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League without winning are Chelsea and Napoli.

programme.title: Karabakh FC VS Copenhagen - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2 / Qarabağ FK vs Copenhagen - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: Qarabag and Copenhagen have faced each other on four previous occasions, with all four of those coming in qualifying matches. Copenhagen progressed from the first of those ties, before Qarabag progressed from the most recent. In 1998-99, Copenhagen won 10-0 over two legs against Qarabag in qualifying for the Cup Winners Cup. Including qualifiers, this remains the Azerbaijani side’s heaviest ever defeat over two legs against a European side.

programme.title: Borussia Dortmund vs Athletic Club - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: Borussia Dortmund and Athletic Club will face each other for the first time in European competition, while this will be Athletic’s first game against a German side in the European Cup/UEFA Champions League. Borussia Dortmund have only lost three of their 16 home games against Spanish teams in the UEFA Champions League, while only Real Madrid have managed to beat them by more than a single goal – doing so in the 2017-18 edition which they went on to win overall.

programme.title: Al Hilal SFC (KSA) vs Al Duhail SC (QAT) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - West MD1
programme.desc: Al Duhail won their first AFC Champions League Elite meeting with Al-Hilal, but Al-Hilal are unbeaten in the six since, including their joint-biggest win in the competition – Al Duhail’s heaviest defeat in the tournament. Qatari teams have lost their last five matches against Saudi sides in the competition; their last win was Al Sadd’s 2-1 victory over Al-Nassr in December 2014. Qatari teams have lost more matches and conceded more goals against Saudi teams than against any other nation.

programme.title: Al Ahli Saudi FC (KSA) vs PFC Nasaf (UZB) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - West MD1
programme.desc: This will be the fifth AFC Champions League Elite meeting between Al-Ahli and Nasaf, with Nasaf’s only win coming in their most recent such game on 2 March 2016 ; Al-Ahli’s most recent game in the competition against Uzbek opposition was a 2-1 win over Pakhtakor Tashkent on 20 May 2019, a win here will see them win two consecutive such games for the first time in competition history. Al-Ahli are unbeaten in each of their last 18 AFC Champions League Elite games, including the final of the 2024-25 edition ; avoiding defeat here will see them equal Gamba Osaka for the joint third-longest such run in the competition.

programme.title: Chengdu Rongcheng FC vs Gangwon FC (KOR) - AFC Champions League Elite 2025/2026 - East MD2
programme.desc: Chengdu Rongcheng will face Gangwon for the first time in AFC Champions League Elite; each of the last three games in the competition between teams from Korea and China have been won by the former by an exact 2-1 score, including Gangwon’s win over Shanghai Shenhua in the first round of the 2025-26 season. Gangwon beat Shanghai Shenhua 2-1 in their first ever AFC Champions League Elite game at home; the last Korean side to suffer at least one defeat in their first two games in the competition is Jeju United in 2011, while no side from Korea has suffered defeat in their first away game in the AFC Champions League Elite.

programme.title: FK Bodø/Glimt vs Tottenham Hotspur - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2
programme.desc: The only previous meetings between Bodø/Glimt and Tottenham came in May of this year, with the English side winning home and away in the UEFA Europa League semi-finals, before going on to lift the trophy. programme.title: My Faith in Sport
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab.Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan

programme.title: Bayer 04 Leverkusen vs PSV Eindhoven - UEFA Champions League 2025/26 - MD2

programme.title: My Faith in Sport
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab.Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan

programme.title: Beauty UFC 317 / MMA UFC 317
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Dubai - Partizan / Košarka - Euroleague: Dubai - Partizan
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Bayern / Košarka - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Bayern
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Virtus Bologna - Real Madrid / Košarka - Euroleague: Virtus Bologna - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Fighter - SC Derby / Košarka - ABA liga: Borac - SC Derby
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Velež - Zrinjski / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Zrinjski
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

For the year of the establishment, the same 2008 was taken in 2008. year when the decision was made in Dubrovnik in the European Championship qualification tournament. After the first season, the Leagues also joined the Italian representatives you soon gave up, while since 2014. the League counts and clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: Part 3.: Leonardo da Vinci went to Milan and then to France, in Rome between Michelangelo and Rafael still ruled a competition that promoted their creativity. By order of Pope Julius II. Michelangelo started painting the Sistine Chapel ceiling, while Rafael had the task of painting a hall not far away, in which the pope accepted important statesmen. July II. was succeeded by Pope Leon X., who made political agreements with art and thus sought to defend himself against the attacks of the French. The Protestant Reformation spread throughout Europe at the time and also stumbled on the Italian peninsula. In a deep division between loyalty to the client and religion, Michelangelo was hidden for two months from attacks raging in Florence. He decided to pour his deepest feelings in the last period, and at that time the last judgment was created. Po naročilu papeža Julija II. se je Michelangelo lotil poslikave stropa Sikstinske kapele, medtem pa je imel Rafael nalogo, da nedaleč stran poslika dvorano, v kateri je papež sprejemal pomembne državnike. Julija II. je nasledil papež Leon X., ki je z umetnostjo sklepal politične dogovore in se tako skušal ubraniti pred napadi Francozov. Leonardo je prvi od treh velikanov italijanske renesanse zapustil svet. Rafael je po naročilu papeža ustvaril tapiserije za Sikstinsko kapelo, kmalu zatem pa je tudi on prerano odšel. Protestantska reformacija se je takrat razširila po vsej Evropi in tudi na italijanskem polotoku zanetila nemir. V globoki razklanosti med zvestobo naročnikom in vero se je Michelangelo dva meseca skrival pred napadi, ki so divjali v Firencah. Odločil se je, da bo v zadnjem obdobju v umetnost prelil svoja najgloblja občutja, in takrat je nastala Poslednja sodba.RENAISSANCE: THE BLOOD AND THE BEAUTY / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Emma Frank.

programme.title: Henrik's freedom, documentary portrait, Mon. / Henrikova svoboda, dokumentarni portret, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Meško Primož ... Hinko Smrekar was a sparkling painter, graphic artist and cartoonist, companion of the greats of Slovene literature and fine arts between the two wars. / R: Meško Primož... Hinko Smrekar je bil iskriv slikar, grafik in karikaturist, sopotnik velikanov slovenske literature in likovne umetnosti med obema vojnama.
programme.desc: In 1942, Italian occupiers took Hinka Henry Smrekar, one of our most important artists of the first half of the 20th century, to a car shooting range called "Green Henry". Freedom was the basic foundation of his life and creation, as he wrote, did not "forced himself from the Pendreks and Bajonetov not to watch and think with his own head." He commented artistically by domestic and world events, and in the famous cycle the mirror of the world visionary announcement of the catastrophic dimensions of the 2nd World War. In the documentary film, the artist is portrayed by actor Marko Plantan, a researcher who, with the help of various experts in the viewer, leads the outposts of Smrekar's life, and AGRFT student Tina Resman. In addition to his most famous works, the cycles of the world and the seven heads of sins, the masquerade of Slovene artists and Slovene literary literary artists or caricatures of his contemporaries and drawings with a fantastic theme, the film shows a number of other works, including the depictions of Ivan Cankar, with whom he was tied to his close friendship. The different sides of his personality, which were characterized by the consequences of the war and the mental illness, are revealed. He recognized his characteristic mood himself in the state of "VasezaPriness" and "fools fools", which has the only task of entertaining the audience. The artist's image also revives in the interpretation of his critical records of existing social political events and more intimate poetic confessions. Screenplay Cvetka Bevc, directed by Primož Meško, director of photography Aleš Živec. / Italijanski okupatorji so leta 1942 Hinka Henrika Smrekarja, enega naših najpomembnejših likovnih ustvarjalcev prve polovice 20. stoletja, odpeljali na strelišče z avtomobilom, ki so ga imenovali »zeleni henrik«. Svoboda je bila osnovni temelj njegovega življenja in ustvarjanja, kot je sam zapisal, se ni dal »niti od pendrekov in bajonetov prisiliti, da ne bi gledal in mislil z lastno glavo.« Umetniško je komentiral domače in svetovno dogajanje in v znamenitem ciklusu Zrcalo sveta vizionarsko napovedal katastrofične razsežnosti 2. svetovne vojne. V dokumentarno igranem filmu umetnika upodablja igralec Marko Plantan, raziskovalko, ki s pomočjo različnih strokovnjakov gledalca vodi po postojankah Smrekarjevega življenja, pa študentka AGRFT Tina Resman. Poleg njegovih najbolj znanih del, ciklusov Zrcalo sveta in Sedem naglavnih grehov, Maškarade slovenskih likovnih umetnikov in Slovenskih literatov ali karikatur njegovih sodobnikov in risb s fantastično tematiko, je v filmu prikazana še vrsta drugih del, med njimi upodobitve Ivana Cankarja, s katerim ga je vezalo tesno prijateljstvo. Ob tem se razkrivajo različne plati njegove osebnosti, ki so ga zaznamovale posledice vojne in psihična bolezen. Svoji značilni razpoloženji je sam prepoznaval v stanjih »vasezaprtosti« in »norčijah bedastega Avgusta«, ki ima edino nalogo, da zabava občinstvo. Umetnikova podoba po svoje oživi tudi v interpretaciji njegovih kritičnih zapisov o obstoječem družbeno političnem dogajanju in intimnejših poetičnih izpovedih. Scenarij Cvetka Bevc, režija Primož Meško, direktor fotografije Aleš Živec.

As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Swiss army, infinite crisis? by Françoise Weilhammer and Xavier Nicolsono the times in which the Swiss militia army was a source of national pride. Reduced effective, need for modernization, resignation from key places, corruption scandals, management problems. For months the worrying news follows each other without stopping. Our army seems to be no longer appropriate to today's needs and its degree of defense is alarming. Is Switzerland's security in danger? Will the new federal councilor Martin Pfister be able to correct the shot in an increasingly complex and unstable geopolitical situation? Migros, a hundred years of service and strategy of Laurent nègre and François Roulet Migros, one of the major groups of large retailers in Switzerland, celebrates the 100th anniversary this year. In 1925, Gottlieb Duttweiler, Swiss entrepreneur and politician, Fonda Migros, a small commercial enterprise that proposes a novelty: buying and distributing goods passing directly from the manufacturer to the final consumer and this in order to reduce prices. Duttweiler is considered a visionary of the retail trade that he fought to improve the daily life of customers and collaborators. But what remains of this humanist and social approach to Migros employees today? How has this exemplary company over time become a powerful group over time with a turnover of 32 billion francs? / Esercito svizzero, crisi infinita? di Françoise Weilhammer e Xavier NicolSono lontani i tempi nei quali l’Esercito di milizia svizzero era motivo di orgoglio nazionale. Effettivi ridotti, necessità di modernizzazione, dimissioni dai posti chiave, scandali di corruzione, problemi di gestione. Da mesi le notizie preoccupanti si susseguono senza sosta. Il nostro Esercito sembra non essere più adeguato alle esigenze odierne e il suo grado di difesa è allarmante. La sicurezza della Svizzera è forse in pericolo? Riuscirà il nuovo Consigliere federale Martin Pfister a correggere il tiro in una situazione geopolitica sempre più complessa e instabile? Migros, cent’anni tra servizio e strategia di Laurent Nègre e François Roulet Migros, uno tra i maggiori gruppi della grande distribuzione in Svizzera, festeggia quest’anno il 100° anniversario. Nel 1925, Gottlieb Duttweiler, imprenditore e politico svizzero, fonda Migros, una piccola impresa commerciale che propone una novità: acquistare e distribuire merci passando direttamente dal produttore al consumatore finale e questo allo scopo di ridurre i prezzi. Duttweiler è considerato un visionario del commercio al dettaglio che ha lottato per migliorare la vita quotidiana di clienti e collaboratori. Ma cosa resta oggi di questo approccio umanista e sociale per i dipendenti Migros? Come si è trasformata nel tempo questa esemplare azienda diventata negli anni un potente gruppo con un fatturato di 32 miliardi di franchi?

A photographic production his capable of moving in a cultural environment in which borders came to fall. Between the Appenzello and Bavaria, between Ticino and Europe, between reality and caricature. / Entriamo nel mondo della fotografia attraverso gli occhi di un uomo che nel Malcantone fece da ponte fra Svizzera tedesca e Ticino, fra protestantesimo e mondo cattolico. Un’occasione per riscoprire il lavoro di Eugenio Schmidhauser che innovò l’immaginario del Ticino di inizio Novecento. Una produzione fotografica la sua capace di muoversi in un ambiente culturale in cui venivano a cadere le frontiere. Tra l’Appenzello e la Baviera, tra il Ticino e l’Europa, tra la realtà e la caricatura.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: Just in these days, sixty years ago, one of the fundamental pages of international pop rock was written: on May 12, 1965 at the RCA Studios of Hollywood I Rolling Stones recorded the single (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction which would be published in the United States on June 6, 1965, quickly leaping at the head of the Billboard Hot 100. Keith Richards who in one one cleared cleared up to the top of the rankings the most acidic distortions and proclaimed the British Invasion as a cultural and social phenomenon of global scope. Paganini has chosen to dedicate the episode of Sunday 18 May to this anniversary - from 10.30 on RSI LA1 - however, facing it indirectly: first of all commissioning the Balkan Lovers group a new version of (I Cant Get No) Satiscation, transposing it from the era and gender to affirm its symbolic and transversal cultural value. The second reference to the Stones is given by the documentary Catching Fire, the story of Alexis Bloom and Svetlana Zill's Anita Playergg. Model, actress and icon of style, Anita Palenberg was linked to the Rolling Stones both by the heart issues (girlfriend first of Brian Jones and then Keith Richards, from whom she had three children) both from artistic aspects, acting as a real muse and inspiring for the group's lestetic. The film is based on the autobiography of the Palenberg - entitled Black Magic - which remained unpublished and found by the children after his death in 2017. For this reason, the intimate and posthumous reading of the pages of the diary was entrusted to the voice of Scarlett Johansson. - Catching Fire, the story of Anita Playlenberg - (I Cant Get no) Satiscation / Proprio in questi giorni, sessantanni fa, si scriveva una delle pagine fondamentali del pop rock internazionale: il 12 maggio 1965 agli RCA Studios di Hollywood i Rolling Stones registravano infatti il singolo (I cant get no) Satisfaction che sarebbe stato pubblicato negli Stati Uniti il 6 giugno 1965, balzando rapidamente in testa alla Billboard Hot 100. Si trattò del primo grande successo del gruppo di Mick Jagger e Keith Richards che in un sol colpo sdoganava in cima alle classifiche le distorsioni più acide e proclamava la British invasion come un fenomeno culturale e sociale di portata globale. Paganini ha scelto di dedicare a questo anniversario la puntata di domenica 18 maggio - dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1 - affrontandolo però indirettamente: innanzitutto commissionando al gruppo Balkan Lovers una nuova versione di (I cant get no) Satisfaction, trasponendola di epoca e di genere per affermarne il valore culturale simbolico e trasversale. Il secondo riferimento agli Stones è dato dal documentario Catching Fire, la storia di Anita Pallenberg di Alexis Bloom e Svetlana Zill. Modella, attrice e icona di stile, Anita Pallenberg fu legata ai Rolling Stones sia da questioni di cuore (fidanzata prima di Brian Jones e poi di Keith Richards, da cui ebbe tre figli) sia da aspetti artistici, fungendo da vera e propria musa e ispiratrice per lestetica del gruppo. Il film è basato sullautobiografia della Pallenberg - intitolata Black Magic - rimasta inedita e ritrovata dai figli dopo la sua morte nel 2017. Per questo, la lettura intima e postuma delle pagine del diario è stata affidata alla voce di Scarlett Johansson. - Catching Fire, la storia di Anita Pallenberg - (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.sub-title: Murder in Las Vegas / Omicidio a Las Vegas
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. We know them. A series that punctures the RSI schedule makes us know the great treasures of the planet that hosts us. The Canal du Midi or Canal des Deux Mers (in Occitan: Canal de Las Doas Mars / Canal of Miègjorn) is an artificial channel that is located in MIDI, in fact, between the cities of Toulouse and Sète, port on the Mediterranean Sea which was founded precisely as the term of the canal. In the original intentions of the seventeenth century, the construction of the Canal du Midi was to connect the Atlantic Locean and the Mediterranean, thus avoiding the long circumnavigation of Spain (allepocate enemy country) and the risk of running into piracy actions, allowing to save a journey lasting about a month. The work was officially inaugurated on May 15, 1681 with the name of Canal Royal de Languedoc. It was built under the supervision of Pierre-Paul Riquet, a rich landlord who went bankrupt due to large costs incurred and died in 1680, a few months before opening the channel navigation. The construction requested the work of 12,000 workers for a period of 15 years. / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita. Il Canal du Midi o Canal des Deux Mers (in occitano: Canal de las Doas Mars / Canal del Miègjorn) è un canale artificiale che si trova nel Midi, appunto, tra le città di Tolosa e Sète, porto sul Mar Mediterraneo che venne fondato proprio in quanto termine del canale. Nelle intenzioni originarie del XVII secolo la costruzione del Canal du Midi doveva collegare lOceano Atlantico e il Mediterraneo, evitando quindi la lunga circumnavigazione della Spagna (allepoca paese nemico) e il rischio di incappare in azioni di pirateria, permettendo di risparmiare un viaggio della durata di circa un mese. Lopera venne inaugurata ufficialmente il 15 maggio 1681 col nome di Canal Royal de Languedoc. Fu costruita sotto la supervisione di Pierre-Paul Riquet, un ricco possidente che andò in bancarotta a causa dgli ingenti costi sostenuti e morì nel 1680, pochi mesi prima dellapertura alla navigazione del canale. La costruzione richiese lopera di 12.000 operai per un periodo di 15 anni.

Result: a crowd of funny, Decalee stories, in tone sometimes a little mocking but always tender. The Signs emission has made his portrait, between Paris where he resides and the city of Rolle for a dedication session to meet the Swiss public. / Nikesco, alias Nicolas Combes, est un auteur de BD français bien connu des personnes sourdes. Depuis 2020, il a publie deux romans graphiques, Le Bruit des Gens tome 1 et 2, dans lesquels il met en scène son propre quotidien de sourd dans un monde d’entendants bruyants. Resultat : une foule d’histoires drôles, decalee, au ton parfois un peu moqueur mais toujours tendre. L’emission Signes a realise son portrait, entre Paris où il reside et la ville de Rolle pour une seance de dedicace à la rencontre du public suisse.

programme.title: A bon entendeur
programme.sub-title: Medicaments with unit: Economy or illusion? / Medicaments à l’unite : economie ou illusion ?
programme.desc: The costs of the health explode in Switzerland, our insurance premiums too. Each year, more than 600 million francs in drugs leave in the trash. Attachment often linked to packaging ill -adapted to the treatments prescribed by the doctors. To change the situation, some pharmacists test the distribution of pills to the unit. Is it a real solution to reduce the costs of the health or the powder to the eyes? "A good hearing" takes stock, Tuesday evening, from 8:10 pm, on RTS1. / Les coûts de la sante explosent en Suisse, nos primes d’assurance aussi. Chaque annee, plus de 600 millions de francs de medicaments partent à la poubelle. Du gaspillage souvent lie à des emballages mal adaptes aux traitements prescrits par les medecins. Pour changer la donne, certains pharmaciens testent la distribution des pilules à l’unite. Est-ce une vraie solution pour reduire les coûts de la sante ou de la poudre aux yeux ? « A bon entendeur » fait le point, mardi soir, dès 20h10, sur RTS1.

programme.title: Temps present
programme.sub-title: Sarah Oberson, Episode 2, disappearance in a black December / Sarah Oberson, episode 2, la disparition dans une decennie noire
programme.desc: Little Sarah Oberson my mysteriously disappeared during a black December. In the 80s, nearly 20 children disappear. Some are dead, others have vanished. This was the case of Sylvie Bovet, who disappeared 4 months before Sarah Oberson. Disappearances that intervene while two killers in Pedophilic series crisscross the country, Werner Ferrari and Michel Peiry, known as the sadistic of Romont. Back on this macabre parenthesis in Swiss criminal history. A report by Wilfred Rebette and Sofia Pekmez / La petite Sarah Oberson a disparu mysterieusement au cours d’une decennie noire. Dans les annees 80, près de 20 enfants disparaissent. Certains sont retrouves morts, d’autres se sont volatilises. Ce fut le cas de Sylvie Bovet, disparue 4 mois avant Sarah Oberson. Des disparitions qui interviennent alors que deux tueurs en serie pedophiles quadrillent le pays, Werner Ferrari et Michel Peiry, connu sous le nom du sadique de Romont. Retour sur cette parenthèse macabre dans l’histoire criminelle suisse. Un reportage de Wilfred Rebetez et Sofia Pekmez
